headline: Bitcoin Volatility Index Hit the 98.8th Percentile of Its 30-Day Range
narrative: Bitcoin volatility index rose to 39.56, the 98.8th percentile of its 30-day range. The volatility pipe is the premium options traders pay for a large swing in bitcoin, and a print at the top of that range means that premium is richer than nearly all of the last month. Bitcoin changed hands near 81k, down 2.61 percent.
author: jordan
